name: History Lab Ledger
description: Deterministic ledger for History Lab: commits an approved Historian's Ruling and recomputes the fact-check accuracy score outside the LLM, so the score can never be hallucinated.
_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish` / `anna-app executa publish`; the dev fields (tool_id/type/enabled) are read by `anna-app dev`, which spawns this stdlib-only plugin via `uvx <tool_id>` (project.name in pyproject.toml MUST equal this tool_id). `distribution.active` selects which profile publish forwards: `local` ships the dev-path locator (default, zero release needed); flip to `binary` to ship the self-contained PyInstaller binary per platform from this repo's GitHub Release (tag `history-lab-ledger-v<version>`, built by .github/workflows/build-history-lab-ledger.yml). On `anna-app apps cut`, matrix-nexus mirrors the Release bytes into apps.anna.partners R2 and pins sha256. Replace the `tool-test-...` placeholder with the server-minted tool_id (and rerun for pyproject.toml + ledger.py MANIFEST.name) once you have pushed the app once. This dir is the `history-lab-ledger` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas.
